title: Clustermarket

body:
Clustermarket is a documented equipment scheduling platform from Clustermarket. Platform for scheduling and sharing lab instruments — the coordination layer that multi-instrument labs need before full autonomy.

How it works: It works by collecting each robot's bid for every task and awarding each task to the highest bidder, the standard market-based allocation.

title: Riffyn
description: Documented public process data software (Riffyn) for the Autonomous Lab Orchestrator capability area.
body:
Riffyn is a documented process data software from Riffyn. Cloud software capturing experimental processes as versioned data designs, giving automated labs reproducible data foundations.

How it works: It works by hashing each build step together with the previous step's hash, forming a tamper-evident chain whose head hash attests the full lineage.

Documented uses of this capability area include warehouse automation fleets, surgical robotics, autonomous laboratories, drone delivery networks, and subsea exploration.
